packages.headline: Introducing No Man’s Sky: Cosmos update, live on PS5 today

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
The biggest overhaul to space the No Man’s Sky universe has seen in 10 years.
Introducing No Man’s Sky: Cosmos update, live on PS5 today
Hello, it has been ten years now since the release of No Man’s Sky , and we wanted to do something special to mark the moment.
The Cosmos update brings a massive overhaul to space itself and is free to download for existing PlayStation players today, and it’s a massive one.
Space is such a huge part of No Man’s Sky, but space itself has remained largely unchanged in all our ten years of updates! 
With Cosmos we wanted to make space feel truly alive. We ‘ve added asteroid belts, space hulks, outposts, missions, strange anomalies, and tons of mystery to explore. There’s so much to do in space that we’ve added a beautiful map to plot and keep track of every system.
Expeditions have become a very popular feature of No Man’s Sky. For our 10th year, we have done something a bit special. Each milestone of the anniversary expedition will correspond to a specific No Man’s Sky update from the 40+ we have released over the last decade. Each milestone’s gameplay reflects some of the features that were introduced with that update, peppered with some interesting logs about how that update came into being. It’s like a journey through time, and honestly we’ve found it a little emotional to put together.
Cosmos is a massive update, but it’s also just another step in our journey together. Right from the beginning, our game, our updates and our patch notes are a love letter from us to the community. Thank you so much for joining us.

Available for XBOX Insiders: More Ways to Customize, Play, and Connect
Starting today, XBOX Insiders can begin trying out a new set of console features designed to give players more choice, more control, and easier ways to stay connected to the games and communities they love. Whether personalizing how a console starts up, customizing how you show up, finding games and achievements faster, or helping cloud gaming and party chat work more seamlessly in the background, these updates are designed to help players spend less time navigating and more time playing.
Players have always made XBOX their own, now they have even more ways to personalize the experience. Earlier this year, XBOX Insiders got a first look at the new startup animation that welcomes players when they power on their console. Starting today, players can choose which startup animation they see, with options spanning from XBOX One through the latest generation. Whether revisiting a favorite era or celebrating their XBOX journey, players can select the experience that feels right for them. This new setting can be found under Settings > System > Startup , where players can also still choose whether the animation plays with sound or not.
Personalization doesn’t stop at startup. Last month, we gave players more insight into badges they’ve earned. Starting today, XBOX Insiders have more control over how those badges are showcased, with the ability to feature up to five badges in their profile card showcase and hide individual badges from their public profile.
Getting back to the games and achievements that matter most should be simple. Starting today, XBOX Insiders can use a new local search feature to quickly find specific games and achievements within large lists.
Available in My games & apps , official club achievement lists, and profile achievement history, local search works alongside existing filters and sorting options to help players find what they’re looking for faster.
Improved Remote Play Experience
Game from more places with even better streaming quality. With XBOX Remote Play, players can stream from their XBOX consoles to PCs, phones, TVs, and other devices. Now, XBOX Insiders in Alpha Skip-Ahead and Alpha on XBOX Series X|S can preview higher-quality XBOX Remote Play streaming, with support for up to 1440p resolution and increased video bitrates for sharper visuals and smoother gameplay on supported devices.

packages.headline: Introducing Dead or Alive 6 Last Round’s new fighter, Minato

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Details on the new fighter’s combat style and backstory ahead of tomorrow’s roster debut.
Introducing Dead or Alive 6 Last Round’s new fighter, Minato
When we launched Dead or Alive 6 Last Round back in June, we promised that the game’s launch was just the beginning. Tomorrow, the next evolution of the title begins as we introduce the highly anticipated new character, Minato, into the mix. We can’t wait to see what everyone thinks of the new character once they get the chance to play as her, but first, let me give a quick introduction on who Minato is and what she’s all about.
Minato is a seemingly ordinary female student attending school in Tokyo. She’s a cheerful and outgoing girl who could be found anywhere, yet there’s an air of otherworldliness about her. While it’s known that she lives on her own away from her parents, much of her private life remains a mystery, and although she’s well-liked by her friends, they also view her as a mysterious person.
That said, Minato occasionally displays astonishing physical abilities. She began dancing as a casual hobby, with the simple goal of making both dancers and spectators feel cheerful and positive. She then went on to make her debut at a world-class dance competition and won first place on her very first try, earning her the nickname Tokyo JK.
Around that time, Minato began disappearing somewhere in a hurry after school and on weekends. She claims it’s part-time work, but the true nature of her activities remains unclear. Occasionally, she is seen chatting amiably on her smartphone with someone named NiCO.
To this day, Minato’s true identity and real purpose remain shrouded in mystery.
Behind Minato’s gentle appearance lies extraordinary physical ability. Having already won a world-class dance competition, she applies her sense of rhythm, athleticism, and empathy to combat as well.

This month, master survival and uncover ancient secrets in RuneScape: Dragonwilds, run the squared circle your way in WWE 2K26, descend into the monster-filled ruins of Ballbylon in Ball x Pit, or turn everyday household objects into lovers, friends or enemies in Date Everything!. All these titles and more are available in September’s PlayStation Plus Game Catalog lineup*. Meanwhile, PlayStation Plus Premium welcomes Mega Man X Command Mission and Metro Redux. The full lineup will be available to play on September 15, unless otherwise noted. 
PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium | Game Catalog 
On RuneScape’s forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft in this co-operative survival adventure. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can you hope to face the ferocious Dragon Queen. Embark on quests, level your skills and explore a beautiful hand-crafted world. This all-new adventure blends high-fantasy and iconic RuneScape lore on a brand new continent. RPG systems reward you with unique abilities and spells as you progress through each skill. Battle legendary RuneScape creatures like Zogres, challenge Black Knights and the entirely new and fearsome Garou, all set to a sweeping soundtrack of reorchestrated RuneScape classics and hours of brand new music.
Run the world’s greatest show your way and live out your WWE fandom to the fullest. Experience the most expansive gameplay to date with rebellious Legends of the Attitude Era and Superstars of today. Rewrite wrestling history and relive CM Punk’s greatest rivalries in a world where The Voice of the Voiceless never left, including fantasy historical scenarios. Punk’s rise, rebellion, and return make this the most personal Showcase yet.

Treasure hunters from far and wide flock to the city’s tomb to seek their fortune, plumbing the depths in search of Ballbylon’s scattered riches. Few return. The pit plays host to armies of barbaric creatures, hellbent on ending your quest before it even begins. Armed with a growing arsenal of magic-infused projectiles, batter your way through multiple levels of increasingly challenging obstacles to claim the ultimate prizes and rebuild New Ballbylon. Ball x Pit is a fast-paced fantasy roguelite where heroes must find the balls to plunge deeper into a seemingly bottomless pit of monsters. Develop arcane ammunition and resources in pursuit of treasure, recruiting additional heroes to aid you in your perilous quest. Ball x Pit will be available September 22 in the US, the UK and Japan.
Date Everything! brings an exciting new twist on the dating simulator genre. Your BFA in customer service unfortunately goes to waste as you lose your job to AI. But… a mysterious stranger sends a gift – magical glasses called ‘Dateviators’ – which make your house come alive and dateable! Each dateable object will open up, have their own stories and potentially become your lovers, friends, or enemies. With an exhaustive Who’s Who of voice actors keeping you company on your journey? Date Everything! will be available today, September 9 in the US and the UK, and September 10 in Japan.

『メトロイド ラヴェナス』発表。2Dメトロイドシリーズ最新作、今作も高難度か
任天堂は9月9日、「Nintendo Direct 2026.9.9」にて『 メトロイド ラヴェナス 』を発表した。対応プラットフォームはNintendo Switch 2。2027年1月28日の発売を予定している。
『メトロイド ラヴェナス』は任天堂の探索型アクションゲーム『メトロイド』シリーズの最新作だ。2021年にNintendo Switch向けに発売された『メトロイド ドレッド』の流れを汲む2Dスタイルの作品となる。
公開された映像では、主人公のサムス・アランが敵のエネルギーを吸収する新アクションがお披露目されている。これは『メトロイド』シリーズの象徴的な敵である人工浮遊生命体「メトロイド」の能力であり、前作『メトロイド ドレッド』の出来事を経てサムスが習得したものである。そのため、ストーリーの時系列は『メトロイド ドレッド』の後になると同時に、文字通りの「メトロイド」と化したサムスが戦う最新作になるようだ。
また、サムスと鳥人像のamiiboのほか、ゲームソフト本体と豪華特典が同梱された『メトロイド ラヴェナス スペシャルエディション』も同時発売になる。
なお、前作『メトロイド ドレッド』はスペインのデベロッパーであるMercurySteamが2017年発売の『メトロイド サムスリターンズ』（ニンテンドー3DS）から続投するかたちで開発を担当した。本稿執筆時点でMercurySteamからの発表はないものの、象徴的なカウンターアクションである「メレーカウンター」と思しき動きが映像内で確認されることから、同じ布陣による作品になるのかもしれない。

ネストピは9月9日、作業用ADV『Chill with You : SHIOI’s Sparkling Scenes』を発表した。
少女と一緒に作業ゲーム新作『Chill with You : SHIOI’s Sparkling Scenes』発表。今度のお相手は勉強サボりがちギャル、現実にリンクして通話場所と時間が変化する
デベロッパーのネストピは9月9日、作業用ADV『Chill with You : SHIOI’s Sparkling Scenes』を発表した。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam）。本発表に合わせてSteamストアページも公開されている。
『Chill with You : SHIOI’s Sparkling Scenes』は日本のデベロッパー、ネストピが手がける新作の作業用アドベンチャーゲームだ。プレイヤーは「シオイ」という少女とビデオ通話をしながら、彼女がしっかり勉強できるよう共に作業をしていくことになる。
本作はネストピが2025年にリリースした前作『Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story』に連なる作品だが、作品間で物語上のつながりはなく、独立した物語が描かれるという。メインキャラクターの少女「シオイ」は、明るくおしゃれなギャル少女。あっという間に他人と仲良くなれるようなクラスの中心人物だ。プレイヤーはそんな彼女と作業を共にして仲を深め、時折起こる会話を楽しむことができる。
ちなみに前作『Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story』は、これまでに45万本を販売。また、本稿執筆時点で1万2000件以上のSteamユーザーレビューを集め、うち98％が好評とする「圧倒的に好評」のステータスを獲得している人気作だ。好きな時に、好きなだけ作業を行い、自分好みのBGMを聞きつつ可愛らしい少女と作業に没頭できる前作は、勉強や作業時間のお供としてユーザーから非常に高い評価を受けている格好だ。
今作『Chill with You : SHIOI’s Sparkling Scenes』においても、スクリーンショットなどを確認する限り、UI面は前作から目立った変更は行われていないように見受けられる。タイマーや各種のツール、キャラクターとの距離感など、人気だった要素は引き継がれているとみられる。
本作の最新情報はネストピの 公式X やSteam Community、アプリストアページにて告知される。興味のある方はフォローなどしておくといいだろう。ちなみに本発表に合わせ、9月10日から前作『Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story』の Steam版 は25％オフとなり、スマートフォン版は20％となるセールが実施される。前作のメインキャラクター「サトネ」と作業をしたい方は購入を検討してみてもいいかもしれない。
本作はプレイヤーの作業を補佐するためのゲームだ。通常のADVとは異なり、プレイヤーが作業することで物語が進む、ある意味ツールのようなゲームである。プレイヤーはゲーム内の環境音やBGMを自由に選択・調整でき、作業用のポモドーロタイマーやToDoリストなどの効率化ツールを使用可能であるとのこと。魅力的な少女と自分好みの静謐な時間を自由にカスタマイズできるそうだ。

packages.headline: 『PowerWash Simulator』開発元、『PowerWash』以外のプロジェクトを中止していた。ひとまず『PowerWash Simulator 2』に注力、でも完全新作は諦めない

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
『PowerWash』シリーズで知られるデベロッパーFuturLabが、開発中だった未発表タイトルを中止し、7人が同社を離れていたようだ。
『PowerWash Simulator』開発元、『PowerWash』以外のプロジェクトを中止していた。ひとまず『PowerWash Simulator 2』に注力、でも完全新作は諦めない
『 PowerWash 』シリーズで知られるデベロッパーFuturLabが、開発中だった未発表タイトルを中止し、7人が同社を離れていたようだ。海外メディア This Week in Video Games が匿名の関係者証言を受け、FuturLabへ取材した内容を報じている。
FuturLabはイギリス・ブライトンを拠点とする20年以上の歴史を持つゲーム開発スタジオだ。近年では高圧洗浄機で汚れを落とすシミュレーションゲーム『PowerWash』シリーズが有名だろう。Steamユーザーレビューでは初作『PowerWash Simulator』が約5万件のうち96％が好評とする「圧倒的に好評」、2作目の『PowerWash Simulator 2』は約1万件のうち91％が好評とする「非常に好評」ステータスを獲得。両作ともに現在もピーク時には2000人前後がプレイする人気の衰えない作品だ（ Steam DB ）。
This Week in Video Gamesに寄せられた匿名の証言によれば、FuturLabでは今年6月下旬、『PowerWash Simulator』とは関係のない開発中プロジェクトの中止が伝えられたという。同プロジェクトは2〜3年にわたって開発が進められていたそうだ。そして7月下旬に7人が解雇されていたと証言されている。
FuturLabのCEOを務めるKirsty Rigden氏は同メディアの取材に対し、プロジェクトの中止と7人が会社を離れたことを認めつつ、開発中のプロジェクトについてはプリプロダクション（企画）段階だったと説明。理由としては「コストが見込まれる収益を上回るため」だとしている。続けて、同社は『PowerWash Simulator 2』に全力を注ぎつつ、新たなゲームのプロトタイプの開発にも取り組んでいると述べられている。そのためにスタジオの将来の計画と要件を見直す必要があり、その結果として7人が会社を離れたとのこと。7人が会社を離れたことについて、人員削減によるものかについては機密事項として回答は控えられている。
ちなみに、Rigden氏は今年1月、 GamesIndustry.biz のインタビューにて「いつも2つのプロジェクトを並行して進めてきた」「『PowerWash』だけのスタジオにはなりたくない」と語っており、『PowerWash』シリーズ依存の体制を脱そうとする姿勢も見せていた。今回中止されたプロジェクトは軒並み『PowerWash』シリーズ以外のプロジェクトとのことで、現時点では『PowerWash』頼みに逆戻りしてしまったといえるだろう。とはいえ、『PowerWash』シリーズ以外のすべてのプロジェクトがキャンセルされたわけではなさそうで、今後、新たなアイデアを試しているというプロトタイプが実り、ゲームとして登場することにも期待したい。
『PowerWash Simulator』は、PC（ Steam / Microsoft Store ）/ Nintendo Switch / PS5/PS4 / Xbox Series X|S/Xbox One 向けに配信中。 続編の『PowerWash Simulator 2』は、PC（ Steam / Epic Gamesストア / Microsoft Store ）/ Nintendo Switch 2 / PS5 / Xbox Series X|S 向けに配信中。Xbox/PC Game Pass向けにも提供されている。

In what will almost surely come as a surprise to Super Smash Bros., Nintendogs, and even Kirby fans everywhere, everyone’s favorite powerful pink hero closed out today’s September 2026 Nintendo Direct. This first look at Kirby and the World Beyond came with an early look at gameplay, showing that, per usual, Kirby will be able to use his copy abilities to slay foes.
This looks like a much more open adventure than Nintendo has offered in the past. In fact, Kirby and the World Beyond might be Kirby’s most open experience yet when it launches for Nintendo Switch 2 spring 2027.
"A new 3D adventure is on the horizon for Kirby!" Nintendo confirmed in a press release. "Freely explore an expansive world and put Kirby’s Copy Abilities to creative use as you uncover what awaits in Kirby and the World Beyond."
As noted during the Direct, Kirby and the World Beyond's spring 2027 launch for Switch 2 just so happens to coincide with the franchise's 35th anniversary. Nintendo's Yoshiaki Koizumi promised that more details on this front will be shared "in the future."
It's been a while since we got a proper new Kirby game. Aside from spinoffs like 2025's Kirby Air Riders and reimaginings like 2023's Kirby's Return to Dreamland Deluxe, the last mainline installment in the classic Nintendo franchise arrived with Kirby and the Forgotten Realm when it launched for the original Switch in early 2022.
With a fresh look at a new, more open world and refreshed copy-ability gameplay, fans have already begun to imagine how this next new game will take the series forward. Part of that has seen some drawing comparisons between Kirby's world-hopping antics and Jim Carrey's 1998 film, The Truman Show.

sources.label: Game Developer

The fellowship program, called Nova Games Foundation, aims to offer six-figure grants to 20 young game designers each year.
Mark Cerny and Geoff Keighley launch university-affiliated fellowship program
PlayStation lead architect Mark Cerny and video game show host Geoff Keighley have announced the Nova Games Foundation, a university-affiliated fellowship program aimed at supporting upcoming game developers.
Announced via Game File yesterday , the program intends to offer six-figure grants to 20 young game designers each year. The funding will be "no-strings-attached," meaning that fellows will retain full ownership of their projects with no equity demands.
Nova is committed to help promote the work, and developers are free to pursue publishers and platforms of their choice. The program can help introduce fellows to publishers but won't take a cute, Game File notes.
"I've always wanted to give back, but given my role in the industry, I've never felt it appropriate to commercially invest in games," Keighley tells Game File. "I've never owned stock in a game company or taken a financial stake in a game. Nova is philanthropy: we aren't taking equity or looking to recoup the grants. The return we’re hoping for is creative—helping new voices make games and find their footing."
Cerny and Keighley have each made "multi-million-dollar donations" to establish the foundation, and hope that others will join the efforts. The duo has already hired an executive director, John Maconga, as well as Ashley Corrigan as head of grants.
"There's a personal side to this, too," Keighley tells Game File about Nova Games. "I don't have children, and I've spent a lot of time thinking about what I can do for future generations. Games have been my entire career. I've been incredibly fortunate, and helping someone else build a life in this industry feels like a meaningful way to give back."
Questions remain over Keighley's "neglected" Future Class honorees
